summary: Practise cash counts, reconciliation, custody controls and variance escalation. Review the course outline and see if it fits your team.
lede: Back office cash handling covers the controls and records used to receive, count, reconcile, safeguard and prepare cash for deposit. It is for cashiers, cash-office staff and supervisors who manage daily cash operations, with practical work in verifying counts, analysing variances against transaction records, and documenting custody handovers and exceptions. Participants also practise reconciliation logs and close reporting to support clear follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who receive, count, reconcile, safeguard or supervise cash and related transaction records as part of daily back-office operations.
modules: Cash Close Reporting and Action Plan
